issue.close_reason: dep add and dep remove now each append one audit event (dependency_added / dependency_removed) inside their own transaction via a shared append_dependency_event helper; detail records blocked, blocker, and kind (plus condition for conditional adds). Events are gated on rows actually changed, so idempotent no-op re-adds and re-removes append nothing. Covered by unit tests and a bead changes --latest CLI test; full suite (38 binaries) plus fmt and clippy clean. Shipped in 52160d4.
issue.description:
src/service/dependencies.rs contains no INSERT INTO events. dep add and dep remove commit semantic mutations without advancing the live event sequence.

Acceptance:
- dep add and dep remove each append one event in their own transaction
- event detail records blocked, blocker, and kind
- bead changes --latest advances per mutation
- idempotent no-op dep add appends no event

Refs: plan 6.2.1 P3; ADR-003.
issue.title: Emit audit events for dependency mutations
